name: context_compressor_append_text_to_content
notes: Traced copy of context_compressor_ports.c::cc_append_text_to_content vs LIVE agent/context_compressor.py::_append_text_to_content. Inputs encode <prepend>\t<content_json>. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (documented, inputs avoid): the C port treats the JSON encodings '[]', '""' and 'null' as no-content (returning a quoted text literal), while LIVE distinguishes None (returns bare text), [] (returns [text_block]) and '' (concatenates); the port also does not JSON-escape text containing quotes/backslashes, so text is the fixed quote-free literal WCUP_NOTE and dict/scalar contents (opaque passthrough in C but str()-rendered in LIVE) are limited to one shape-classification-only input.
